title: Step 67-H integrated Admin shell production and browser acceptance
description: MEDIUM-risk QA stage for the complete Step 67 Admin shell. Run production-build SSR acceptance in canonical verification and, when the isolated browser QA environment is available, Chromium/Axe checks at 320px and 1200px covering RTL, accessibility, reflow, keyboard focus, permission-aware navigation, neutral denial, credential privacy, storage boundaries and unavailable-only dashboard authority. No Backend/OpenAPI/database/Product Design/current-state or domain-workspace authority is added.

acceptance_criteria.description: Production Admin build serves Persian RTL login, authenticated shell, dashboard foundation, credential self-service and permitted/denied destination states against an isolated authoritative fixture.
Unauthenticated Admin access redirects to login and public login never leaks the authenticated shell.

Authenticated overview exposes only permission-filtered destinations, read-only assigned scope and an unavailable-only dashboard with no fabricated KPI/count/health/notification data and no /admin/dashboard runtime call.
Credential self-service renders only safe summary fields; secret credential/authenticator material is absent from SSR/browser output.
Known-forbidden and unknown deep links use the same 403 neutral denial without leaking destination identity.
When browser QA is available, Chromium/Axe passes RTL, one-H1, no-horizontal-overflow, 44px targets, keyboard-visible skip focus and WCAG automated checks at 320px and 1200px.
Browser state persists no Admin authentication capability in localStorage/sessionStorage and acceptance fixture observes no backend mutation.
Storefront Quality test harness invokes the Admin browser acceptance without adding Playwright/Axe to production dependencies or modifying workflow files.
No Backend/OpenAPI/database/Product Design/current-state or Steps 68-73 domain workspace mutation is introduced.

MEDIUM-risk closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, CodeQL, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release; no Owner Human Gate required.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 67-H is MEDIUM risk; Human Gate is not required.
